analysis.energy_desc: How intense and active the track feels. High energy = loud, fast, noisy. Low energy = calm, ambient.
analysis.valence_desc: Musical positiveness. High valence = happy, cheerful, euphoric. Low valence = sad, dark, angry.
analysis.danceability_desc: How suitable a track is for dancing based on tempo, rhythm stability, and beat strength.
analysis.acousticness_desc: How acoustic a track sounds. High = real instruments, unplugged. Low = electronic, synthesised.
analysis.instrumentalness_desc: Whether a track contains vocals. High = mostly instrumental. Low = contains singing or speech.
analysis.speechiness_desc: How much spoken word is present. High = spoken word, podcast-like. Low = mostly music.
analysis.liveness_desc: Whether the track sounds like it was performed live with an audience present.
analysis.tempo_desc: The speed of the track in beats per minute (BPM). Higher BPM = faster tempo.

quickstart.title: 🚀 Quick Start Guide
quickstart.intro: Get up and running in a few simple steps — from setup to your first AI-powered playlist.
quickstart.step1_tagline: Enter your keys, connect Spotify, pick your theme.
quickstart.step2_tagline: Tell SpotyVibe what you love (and what to avoid).
quickstart.step3_tagline: Pick a mode, set optional filters, hit Generate.
quickstart.step4_tagline: Preview tracks, like the gems, dislike the misses.

ob.privacy_short: Your keys and taste profile stay on your device. When you generate a playlist, your taste is sent to OpenAI (to get suggestions) and track titles go to Spotify (to verify and save them). Nothing else is tracked.
ob.corpus_scope_note: Heads up: SpotyVibe's artist corpus only covers acts that started in the 1960s or later. Pre-1960s music is intentionally excluded — it sits outside the listening habits we optimise for.
ob.step2_subtitle: SpotyVibe uses an AI provider to generate suggestions. Pick one and add your API key.
ob.openai_key_hint: Paste this from your OpenAI dashboard.
ob.openai_step3: Copy it (you won't see it again)
ob.ollama_step2: Open a terminal and run: ollama pull llama3
ob.ollama_step3: Make sure Ollama is running (it starts automatically after install)
ob.lmstudio_step2: Search for and download a model (e.g. Llama 3, Mistral)
ob.lmstudio_step3: Start the local server (Developer → Start Server)
ob.groq_step2: Go to API Keys and create a new key

priv.title: What gets sent where?
priv.footnote: Applies to the default SpotyVibe setup. Custom LLM endpoints may route data differently.
gen.exploration_hint_1: Familiar — bias toward artists you already know.
gen.exploration_hint_2: Mostly known — a few new artists mixed in.
gen.exploration_hint_3: Balanced — roughly half new artists, moderate novelty.
gen.exploration_hint_4: Mostly new — discovery-led, some familiar anchors.
gen.exploration_hint_5: Adventurous — emerging artists only, high novelty.
gen.exploration_hint_custom: Custom mix — move the slider to jump back to a preset.
af.energy_hint: How intense and active the track feels.
af.energy_learn_more: Higher values push GPT toward loud, fast, driving tracks. Lower values favour calm, ambient music. Leave empty to let any value through.
af.valence_learn_more: Valence is Spotify's 0–100 measurement of emotional tone. High = cheerful, euphoric; low = sad, angry, dark.
af.tempo_learn_more: Typical ranges: slow ballads 60–80, mid-tempo pop 90–110, dance 120–140, fast rock/electronic 140–180.
af.danceability_hint: How suitable a track is for dancing.
af.danceability_learn_more: Based on tempo stability, rhythm regularity, and beat strength. Not the same as "upbeat" — a steady ambient groove can score high.
af.acousticness_learn_more: High = unplugged, live instruments, folk. Low = synths, heavy production, electronic.
settings.playlist_size_learn_more: Max capped at 30 — beyond that GPT starts repeating itself across 10-track fetch blocks, and review fatigue sets in. If you want a longer session, run twice with different presets.
settings.new_artist_pct_hint: Minimum share of suggestions from artists you haven't listened to yet.
settings.new_artist_pct_learn_more: Higher pushes exploration; lower keeps things familiar. The exploration slider above drives this — edit here to override.
settings.new_artist_pct_custom_hint: Differs from the active preset's New Artist % — saved presets are not affected.
settings.model_hint: Which OpenAI model produces your suggestions.
settings.model_learn_more: Higher-tier models cost more per run. For music suggestions the difference is noticeable but not dramatic; gpt-4o-mini is a sensible default.
settings.debug_hint: Log every GPT request and response to a local file.
settings.debug_learn_more: For developers and bug reports. Never affects behaviour. The log file stays on your device — see the Privacy modal.
settings.ui_scale.label: Text size
settings.ui_scale.hint: Scales text only — stored on this device.
